source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3 with Figs. 9.10 to 9.13 (PDF 198-200).

blocks.text: Jab electric field mein kisi area ka chhota tukra (element of area) rakhein to kuch lines of force us mein se guzarti hain (Fig. 9.10). Kisi area se guzarne wali field lines ki number (ginti) ko us area se electric flux kehte hain. Ise Greek letter φₑ se likhte hain. Misal: Fig. 9.10 mein area A se flux 4 hai aur area B se 2.

blocks.alt: Magenta field lines oopar jati aur phailti hain. Neeche jahan qareeb hain, chhota peela area A 4 lines se guzarta hai. Oopar jahan door hain, barabar peela area B 2 lines se.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.10: E ke perpendicular (seedhi khadi) surface se electric flux (kitab ki Figure 9.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flux yani area se guzarne wali lines ki number: A se 4 aur B se 2. Dono area barabar hain, magar A par lines ghani hain, is liye wahan field zyada strong (taqatwar) hai.

Flux ko number ki shakal dene ke liye lines aise banayi jati hain ke field lines ke seedhe (perpendicular) rakhe unit area se guzarne wali lines ki number us point par field ki intensity E ke barabar ho.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse, magenta field teer E daen taraf. (a) Maximum: hara area field ke aar paar khara, vector A daen taraf E ke saath. (b) Minimum: area field ke parallel leta hua, A seedha oopar. (c) Area jhuka hua, A aur E ke darmiyan angle theta; saath peeli dashed patti A cos theta, yani E ke amudi us ka saya (projection).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.11: (a) zyada se zyada; (b) kam se kam; (c) (kitab ki Figure 9.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Area ke tukre ko aam taur par vector area A se dikhate hain: is ki magnitude (miqdar) tukre ke area A ke barabar hoti hai aur direction (rukh) area ke normal (surface par seedhi khadi lakeer) ke saath hoti hai.
Fig. 9.11(a) mein area A field lines ke seedha (perpendicular) rakha hai, is liye EA lines us se guzarti hain. Yahan flux:
Fig. 9.11(b) mein area A field lines ke parallel (mutawazi) rakha hai; koi line is area ko paar nahi karti, is liye flux zero hai:

Fig. 9.11(c) mein A na seedha hai na parallel, balke field E se angle θ par jhuka hua hai. Yahan area ka woh projection (saya) lete hain jo field lines ke seedha ho. Is projection ka area A cosθ hai. Yahan flux:

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein saari lines area se guzarti hain: φ = EA (sab se zyada). (b) mein koi line nahi guzarti: φ = 0 (sab se kam). (c) mein sirf seedha projection A cosθ kaam karta hai: φ = EA cosθ.
Is tarah flat (chapte) tukre se electric flux E aur A ki madad se yeh hai:
Yahan θ field lines aur area ke normal ke darmiyan angle hai. Flux do vectors ka scalar product hai, is liye flux scalar quantity hai (is ki koi direction nahi). Is ki SI unit N m² C⁻¹ hai.
